newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise head has no comment on Suez link.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise head has no comment on Suez link.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux chairman Jerome Monod on Thursday said he had no comment on a rumoured link-up with Compagnie de Suez.

"There is no reason to comment on these rumours. The day that we have something to say, we will," Monod told reporters on the fringes of a signing ceremony of an accord between and France and the Inter-American Development Bank (IABD).
The Le Figaro newspaper said on Tuesday, citing sources close to the affair, that such a link -- often rumoured in the past, was once again under review by the companies.
The companies had no official comment.
